snippet.title: The FIRST Dunbartonshire Derby for 25 YEARS!
snippet.description:

They've worked their way back up through the non leagues and are in the Lowland League currently. They faced off against Dumbarton FC tonight in the KDM Evolution Trophy (Scottish Challenge Cup).

snippet.title: This NYC Football Pitch Doesn’t Feel Real!
snippet.description:
I traveled across the Atlantic to America for the biggest sporting event: the FIFA World Cup! 

But while taking in the football, I knew I had to explore how New York City and it's soccer stadiums .This vlog is the ultimate tour of NYC's hidden football culture and most iconic spots including the legendary Battery Park City Ball Fields beneath the World Trade Center. 

Along the way, I took a detour across Manhattan and Brooklyn to hit the city's legendary bucket-list sights. From cycling the Hudson River bike trail to getting lost in Central Park, walking the historic Brooklyn Bridge, and taking the ferry out to Staten Island—this is New York City through the eyes of a football fan.⚽ 

Have you ever played on a rooftop pitch? Let me know your favorite NYC spot in the comments below!

snippet.title: The ONLY American World Cup FOOTBALL Stadium
snippet.description:

Whilst most stadiums in the USA being used for the World Cup were built for NFL first, soccer second, the Mercedes Benz stadium was built with football (soccer) in mind! It's home to the Atlanta Falcons of the NFL but Atlanta United has the most impressive attendance statistics in the MLS. 

I took the stadium tour and was blown away by one of the greatest stadiums in the United States of America!

snippet.title: Scottish Fans Cause CHAOS in Miami
snippet.description:
Scotland fans, the Tartan Army, have TAKEN OVER MIAMI! We saw some incredible scenes at the MLB stadium (home of the Marlins v Texas Rangers). The baseball fans have never seen an atmosphere like it. The Americans love the Scottish fans.

snippet.title: The World Cup Is Here!
snippet.description:
On the day that the 2026 FIFA World Cup kicks off in Mexico, I met arguably Scotland's best ever World Cup player! Gordon Strachan played in two tournaments in Spain & Mexico in 1982 & 1986. He scored v West Germany and was man of the match v New Zealand. 

I also met some Scotland fans in Glasgow to quiz them on the World Cup ahead. Will Harry Kane be top scorer? How far will Scotland go? Will Messi win it again? Keep watching to find out!
